prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Safeguard Hint: Displays a reassurance hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that existing pet data is bound to your account so progress won't be lost.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in ensures your pet status and collection are safely saved to your cloud account."}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Care Basics Checklist: Adds a pet care checklist screen right at the finish stage introducing how to feed, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_care_checklist"], "new_pet_care_checklist": {"headline": "Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Learn how to summon, feed, or hide your new pet directly from your desktop system tray.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right-click system tray to hide/show pet", "style": "plain"}, {"type": "checklist", "text": "Click pet directly to open interaction menu", "style": "plain"}]}}
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Generation Error Prevention Hint: Adds a guidance hint on photo upload detailing clear lighting and face visibility requirements to reduce pet generation failures.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Ensure single subject, good lighting, and clear front view for optimal pet generation result."}}
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Visibility Status Check: Redesigns the home intro screen into a split layout featuring a direct desktop visibility verification button.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "body": "If you don't see your pet wandering around, check your taskbar or click locate pet.", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Locate Pet on Desktop", "style": "emphasis", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
4: [home, notification] Pet Hatching Status Notification: Enables desktop notification toggle and clear status messaging on the waiting screen while the pet is being generated.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Your New Companion", "body": "We are generating your pet graphics. We will send a desktop notification when ready."}}
5: [choose_path, redesign] Choice Story Scroll Redesign: Redesigns the choose path screen layout to story_scroll format with structured pet selection choice cards.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Choose Your Companion's Journey", "body": "Scroll through available companion paths and select your preferred adventure."}}
6: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stage: Changes the adoption certificate screen layout to stage format featuring an animated pet mascot component.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_welcome", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [sign_in, redesign] Fast Track Sign In Options: Redesigns the sign-in options area with prominent authentication badges to prevent screen stalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Quick Instant Sign-In", "style": "highlight", "role": "sign_in_options"}]}}}
8: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Tip Carousel Flow: Adds interactive tip carousel components and time estimate indicators to the waiting screen during pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Did you know? You can customize pet sounds in settings later.", "style": "calm"}]}}
9: [choose_path, redesign] Path Story Intro Card Redesign: Redesigns the story screen using a card layout with step counters to orient new users.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "card", "show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "body": "Get ready to adopt a pet that lives directly on your desktop."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a helpful sign-in hint without breaking any rules.
Adds a valid new pet care checklist screen after home_intro while retaining all required steps.
Adds helpful photo upload guidance without violating any rules.
Redesigns the home intro overlay cleanly within onboarding bounds.
Enhances the waiting screen while maintaining its primary function.
Redesigns choose path layout while retaining choice options.
Replacing components with only a mascot removes the required official stamp from the certificate.
Replacing sign-in options with a static badge removes sign-in functionality.
Adds informative carousel and estimated wait time during real waiting step.
Redesigns the story screen card while continuing to introduce the pet.
